standard_full: DIN 1:1981 (taper pins with rounded ends, taper 1:50; withdrawn, replaced by DIN EN 22339 = ISO 2339:1986). Only the crown height c max of the DIN 1 table.
scope: 옛 DIN 1(DIN EN 22339·ISO 2339로 대체됨)의 끝단 볼록 높이 c 최대만 — ISO 2339의 끝 모따기 a는 3곳 이상 일치한 호칭 지름이 일부(1–20 mm의 13개)뿐이라 싣지 않았고, 길이 범위도 싣지 않았습니다

verification.checks_done: All pages re-downloaded by the verifier with curl (browser User-Agent) on 2026-11-11 into a separate directory (HTTP 200, text/html); tables re-read with the verifier's own parser (html.parser grid with rowspan/colspan), not the researcher's scripts or raw files. Pages: globalfastener detail_2015 (DIN 1) + detail_248 / 2285 / 5079 (ISO 2339 family), fasten.it din_1 + iso_2339 + din_en_22339, opac producto-172, fasteners.eu DIN/1 + ISO/2339, boltsfastener din-1, theo-schrauben DIN-1 + ISO-2339, schrauben-lexikon ISO_2339, ferrofast iso-2339, fastenerdata din1, boltport din-1 + iso-2339. Verified the DIN 1-only table: 20 diameters x c max against 5 clusters; the ISO 2339 a column was re-counted only to document why it is not published.
problems: d 0.6, 0.8, 25, 30, 40, 50 rest on exactly globalfastener, fasten.it and OPAC (Boltport's near-verbatim page agrees but is excluded).

fasten.it prints the row as 'c' without 'max'; globalfastener, OPAC, fasteners.eu and theo-schrauben print c max. For the six zero-slack diameters the word max is therefore on two of the three counted pages.
The table is a withdrawn standard's dimension (DIN 1:1981); current taper pins follow ISO 2339 / DIN EN 22339, whose end dimension a is a different, smaller number. The scope line says so.
No official preview was found for DIN 1; nothing beyond the T2 pages could be checked.
